# Fenix Protocol -- Full Reference

> Fenix Protocol is a hyperstructure that turns burned XEN into FENIX: burn XEN at a fixed 10,000:1 ratio, then stake FENIX for equity-based yield at a fixed 1.618% annual inflation rate. No admin keys, no pre-mine, no investor allocation.

## What Fenix Protocol is

Fenix Protocol is a hyperstructure: an unowned, unstoppable, free-to-use set of smart contracts that runs forever without maintenance. There are no admin keys and no back doors. FENIX can only be created by burning XEN, so there is no pre-mine and no investor allocation.

## Mechanics

### Proof of Burn

FENIX is minted exclusively by burning XEN, at a fixed ratio of 10,000 XEN to 1 FENIX. Burning is irreversible and is the only path for FENIX to enter circulation.

### Equity Staking

Stakers deposit FENIX into a dynamic equity pool and receive proportional shares. Stake terms run from 1 to 7,777 days. Longer terms earn a time bonus and larger deposits earn a size bonus, both of which increase the shares credited to the stake.

### Trustless Yield

A fixed 1.618034% annual inflation rate is distributed to stakers in proportion to shares held. Ending a stake before its term or more than 180 days after maturity incurs a penalty.

### Rewards

Adoption and equity reward pools accumulate and are flushed on a recurring schedule, distributing their balance to stakers.

## Protocol constants

- XEN to FENIX burn ratio: 10,000:1
- Annual inflation rate: 1.618034%
- Minimum stake term: 1 day
- Maximum stake term: 7,777 days
- Supported chains: 12
- Supported languages: 21

## Reading protocol state

There is no REST or GraphQL API and no API keys. Protocol state is read directly from the contracts over JSON-RPC using standard `eth_call` requests against the addresses above.
